subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: In a formal RFP process, after discussions and negotiations have concluded with the short-listed vendors, what is the required mechanism to formally close negotiations and obtain their final pricing?
options: Request for Best and Final Offer (BAFO)
questions.explain: A BAFO is a formal request allowing short-listed proposers one last opportunity to revise their technical proposals and pricing based on the preceding discussions and negotiations.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: What is a major ethical and practical risk of an agency repeatedly requesting multiple rounds of Best and Final Offers (BAFOs) from the same vendors?
options: It increases the agency's bonding costs
It risks 'auctioning' or technical leveling, signaling to vendors that their prices are known, destroying trust, and reducing the value of initial competitive pricing
It forces vendors to automatically lower their quality
questions.explain: Requesting more than one BAFO is heavily discouraged because it borders on auctioning. Vendors will learn that their first prices don't matter, and it implies the buyer is simply shopping prices back and forth, eroding the integrity of the sealed proposal process.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: An agency issues a formal request for a BAFO with a firm deadline of Friday at 3:00 PM. Vendor A fails to submit any response. According to standard procurement protocols, how is Vendor A evaluated?
options: They are disqualified and removed from the shortlist entirely
Their most recent previous proposal stands as their 'Best and Final' and is evaluated as such
They are given a 24-hour grace period to respond
Their price is automatically increased by 10% as a penalty
questions.explain: Failure to submit a revised BAFO does not disqualify the vendor. Their latest valid submission (original proposal or post-discussion revision) defaults as their final offer.
